description: This file contains the implementation of the HLookup class, which performs horizontal lookup operations within a spreadsheet calculation context. It defines methods for executing the HLOOKUP function, including array handling, argument validation, and search logic.

classes.name: HLookup
classes.description: This class provides an implementation of the HLOOKUP function commonly used in spreadsheet calculations. It enables searching for a value in the top row of a range and returning a value from a specified row in the same column.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs an HLOOKUP operation, searching for a value in the top row of an array and returning a value from a specified row, with optional exact or approximate match logic.

methods.name: hLookupSearch
methods.description: Searches for a lookup value across a specified column in the lookup array, respecting whether an exact match is required.

methods.name: convertLiteralArray
methods.description: Converts a literal array to a standardized internal format, adjusting keys and structure for lookup operations.
